snippet.title: In Print - Trailer
snippet.description:
In Print is a chaotic font-themed rogue-lite shooter where each round’s loser picks a new power-up to build their wild, broken combos. Rain fire with the power of Hellvetica or fly through the skies with Wingdings. Are you ready to destroy your friends—all while sporting your finest office attire? 

In Print is heavily inspired by rounds, I was playing with a friend and had a blast. I wanted more combos, and to be able to play with 4 people which is what inspired In Print. It shares a bunch of the same mechanics but with more emphasis on the online/multiplayer experience, and power ups that focus more on dramatically changing the game vs a stat boost. 

I have a lot more things I want to implement/improve so stay tuned to see how this game develops. If you have any ideas/suggestions let me know as I am always looking for new ways to improve the game.
